## Summary
Printess (browser-based personalization editor, founded 2020, Germany) announces native integration into Infigo as an alternative to MegaEdit. This is significant because it's the first major external editor that competes with / supplements MegaEdit inside the Infigo platform — gives Infigo customers a second editor choice without leaving the storefront.

## Key takeaways
- **Architectural pattern (named source: Michael Zauner, Head of Technical Innovations at Infigo):** Printess embeds natively in Infigo, sitting alongside MegaEdit as a parallel editor option. Storefront, automation, e-commerce remain Infigo; design tool can now be either MegaEdit or Printess.
- **Strategic positioning:** Joint launch at Printing United 2025 (Orlando, Oct 22–24). Infigo customers can pick the editor that best fits a given product — Printess is pitched for photorealistic previews, AI-powered personalization, and complex flexible layouts (photobooks, complex packaging).
- **Why this matters for admins:** If MegaEdit hits a wall on a specific product (e.g., complex photobook automation), Printess is now a sanctioned alternative inside the same Infigo storefront. No need to leave the platform or build custom iframe glue.
- **Printess commercial model:** Cost-per-order subscription, fully cloud, no infrastructure to deploy. Three components: (1) industry-standard design tool for template creation, (2) web customizers for mobile/desktop, (3) print workflows.
- **Quotes for citation:**
  - Zauner (Infigo): "Our customers get the best of both worlds: simple workflows and the ability to handle highly customized, complex products without breaking the user journey."
  - Christoph Schacht (Printess co-founder): "We're enabling businesses to unlock personalization at scale while giving end-users the intuitive and inspiring design experience they expect."
- **Infigo CEO Douglas Gibson quote** (10-year retrospective in same release): customers adopted Infigo "to help create new revenue streams, increase profits through online selling, enhance customer retention … as well as improve workflow and process management."
